gallery_subtitle: Every picture holds a little piece of love ✨
letter_text:
Dear Monalisa,

Some memories become the most beautiful parts of our lives. Thank you for your laughter, your kindness, and all the little moments that mean more than words can explain. I hope this year brings you peace, courage, beautiful surprises, and all the happiness you deserve.

No matter how busy life becomes, you will always have a special place in my heart.

With lots of love 💚
